title: Scaled noise bound by degree parts
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0<\delta\leq 1$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Applying the noise operator with parameter $(1-\delta)/\sqrt{3}$ satisfies $\|T_{(1-\delta)/\sqrt{3}}f\|_4\leq\sum_{k=0}^{n}(1-\delta)^k\|f^{=k}\|_2$, where $f^{=k}$ is the degree-$k$ Fourier part of $f$ and the norms use uniform measure on the cube.
